title: Update displayed contact email in Contact section

requirements.text: Update only the selected Contact section email text (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[6]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/a[1]/span[1]) to display "info.zeroplast@gmail.com" instead of the current email shown in the span.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Contact section’s left card (“Email Us”), the visible email text in the span is exactly "info.zeroplast@gmail.com".
No other elements are changed as part of this edit (e.g., do not modify the surrounding card, headings, or other sections).

constraints: Apply the change ONLY to the user-selected element at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[6]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/a[1]/span[1].
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not change the mailto href attribute or any other link targets unless the user selects those elements explicitly in a separate request.
Do not add backend logic or persistence for contact info.
